apps.name: Hotels MUSE iPhone
apps.notes: Visuals overhaul, photorealistic to the real MB 1987 game: all 8 hotels rebuilt (Royal beige towers, President blue glass + grey wedge roofs, Fujiyama blue-grey cylinders + black caps, Waikiki/Safari barrel-roof bungalows, Taj corner domes + arched door, Le Grand dormers + chimney + red arched door, Boomerang 5-segment crescent + window bands + vent), flat printed windows, flat facility tiles, Bank hipped roof + red door, Town Hall arched door, corrected district colours (Le Grand teal-green, President green, Fujiyama pink), board grain + vignette, dark-green felt table, specular plastic sheen + warm fill light, car headlights + chrome bumpers, softer offset shadows, and the 'Your turn' banner fix. v1.3 crash fix intact; gameplay and deed values unchanged.
